description:
FOUND + FIXED s517b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-15).

REPRO: use IO::Compress::Gzip qw(gzip); use IO::Uncompress::Gunzip qw(gunzip $GunzipError); gzip(\$in => \$gz); gunzip(\$gz => \$out) or die $GunzipError  -- PCL: "Inflation Error: data error" (smartRead asked for 10 header bytes).

FIX (data layer, rule 9a): three facts overlays lib/PCL/Facts/IO/Compress/{Gzip,Zlib,Zip}/Constants.pm, generated from each module's own `use constant` list and literal @EXPORT (scratch/s517b/gen-overlay.pl).  Guard: Pl/t/zlib-01.t section 4 (gzip/gunzip round trip).

=== DONE (s517b) ===
subject: IO::Compress::{Gzip,Zlib,Zip}::Constants are IO:: modules the prototype scan skips by name, so `GZIP_MIN_HEADER_SIZE - GZIP_ID_SIZE` in core IO::Uncompress::Gunzip parsed as a call with argument -GZIP_ID_SIZE (10, not 8) and gunzip read two deflate bytes as header
